headline: Waist-high SE with a touch of period — dawn log session before the sea breeze.
today: Best of it is the early window while the WSW is still light cross and the swell's got a bit of period (up to 8s, 2.8ft on the sets). Once the SSW cross-on fills in mid-morning it goes soft and textured, and by evening the S onshore closes it out. Log or groveler, ride the incoming toward the 9:47 high, don't expect much after lunch.

daysToWatch.note: Longer period SE at a good angle (up to 9.3s) but SSE onshore/cross-on sits on it all day — clean-ish only at dawn.
NW offshore all day and a good SE angle, but the swell's small and short-period. Glassy dawn log at best.
